scope: Data-driven projectile range/lifetime mechanism: GenericSkill gains get_projectile_lifetime() / get_projectile_max_range() getters that read optional per-tier skill JSON fields (projectile_lifetime / projectile_max_range) via get_stat(); Projectile._ready() overrides its instance lifetime / max_distance_travelled from skill_parent when those methods exist. v1 behavior-zero-change: with no JSON field present, getters return the existing defaults (2.0 s lifetime / 300 px max range), so every projectile behaves exactly as before. Future per-skill tuning = adding JSON fields (subsequent VALUE_PATCHes).

entities.expected_runtime_effect: Getters read optional per-tier skill dict fields (same source as get_force's projectile_speed). With no fields declared they return 2.0 / 300, preserving current behavior exactly.

In _ready, after skill_parent_weakref is set, Projectile reads skill_parent.get_projectile_lifetime()/get_projectile_max_range() when those methods exist and assigns them to lifetime/max_distance_travelled. skill_parent lacking the methods (or default getters) leaves original defaults untouched -> zero behavior change in v1.
